subject.title: feat(cli): add `agents` and `<agent> models` runtime discovery commands

question: Should acpx add stable runtime-discovery commands, and if so which namespace and machine-readable output contract should become part of the CLI API?
rationale: VISION.md supports backend-friendly structured discovery, but the proposed top-level keywords and JSON shapes create durable compatibility commitments and collide with the existing arbitrary-agent command model.

options.title: Sponsor narrowed discovery
options.body: Approve discovery under a collision-resistant namespace with ephemeral model handshakes, secret-safe output, complete docs, tests, and runtime proof.

options.title: Accept top-level verbs
options.body: Reserve `agents` and `models` explicitly and document the migration path for custom agents that already use those names.

options.title: Keep discovery external
options.body: Decline new core verbs and have downstream tools compose existing config and ACP/session surfaces themselves.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrowed discovery
recommendation.body: Approve discovery under a collision-resistant namespace with ephemeral model handshakes, secret-safe output, complete docs, tests, and runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Bob is the strongest available routing signal for the CLI grammar and output contract that require product-level stabilization.
